text: Good evening. I am writing about my granddaughter Ellie, who is 6 and staying with me while her parents are away for the night. She was a little off colour yesterday and today she has had a temperature. I took it about twenty minutes ago and it was 38.2. When I was getting her into her pyjamas I noticed some small dark red and purple spots on her legs and a couple on her tummy, like tiny pinpricks, with one or two bigger patches that look a bit like bruises. I remembered reading that you should press a glass on them, so I did, and they did not go away under the glass, you could still see them clearly through it. I also think her colour is not right. She looks quite pale, and her skin on her arms and legs has gone sort of mottled and blotchy, a bit marbled looking. Her lips seem paler than usual too. I have written down what I've seen so I can tell you properly. Her mum is not reachable until morning, so I would like to know what you advise me to do.
